name: Nico Wells
life: “I still remember coming back to work a day earlier than I was ready.” People around Lighthouse Cove know Nico by a small Wednesday habit. Nico takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: I know what it costs to return without being cured of ordinary sadness. I am walking home with my colleague twice this week.
appearance: Nico has a deep crease beside the mouth when smiling. Look for a long plait tucked inside the collar. Off duty, the familiar outfit is a brown corduroy jacket with a watch on a cracked leather band. In conversation Nico turns fully toward the person speaking.
personality: Nico uses precise names for tools and very approximate names for feelings. People who know Nico well listen to what gets repaired after a difficult conversation.
agenda: To keep the two promised walks home.
family: Remy Rizzo is Nico’s cousin. Nico gets to change the plan. Remy offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The pawned trumpet*, Remy says, “I lent my birthday room for a joint rehearsal.”
connections: Omar Blake. A private call home and a quiet walk away from work serve different parts of the same return.

reactions.response: Nico asks the person crying whether they want to go somewhere quieter, leaving them control over the next step.
